jobs.description:
1 Lead Engineer - Applied AI & Data Products from now

Your Tasks
 * AI-Powered Product Architecture: Design and own the architecture of AI-enhanced software products using modern cloud services and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain).
 * Applied LLM Expertise: Apply Large Language Models (LLMs), cognitive services, and related technologies to solve complex, high-impact customer problems independently.
 * Customer Consulting: Lead workshops and technical discussions with product managers, designers, and customer stakeholders, representing SQUER with confidence and identifying where AI adds measurable value.
 * Scalable Systems Design: Architect scalable data pipelines and APIs that power intelligent features in production-grade environments, taking full technical ownership.
 * Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and develop engineers within your team, shape our applied AI engineering practices, and ensure project and team success.
 * Thought Leadership: Represent SQUER's applied AI expertise externally - through client relationships, internal knowledge-sharing, or community engagement.

Your Qualifications
 * Extensive Software Engineering Experience: Several years of hands-on and architectural experience in software engineering (e.g., Python, Java, C#, JS/TS, or similar).
 * Applied AI Depth: Proven, independent experience applying AI services in production (e.g., LLMs, NLP APIs, cognitive services), not just experimenting.
 * Cloud Platform Ownership: Confident designing and deploying AI-driven features on AWS, GCP, or Azure at production scale.
 * Data & API Architecture: Strong understanding of data processing, APIs, and databases (SQL & NoSQL), with the ability to make architectural decisions independently.
 * Leadership & Mentorship: Ability to guide, coach, and develop other engineers, and to take responsibility for a team's delivery and satisfaction.
 * Customer-Facing Confidence: Comfortable representing SQUER independently to customers with a high degree of professionalism.
 * Languages: Fluency in German and English.

Your Benefits
Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

 * Ownership & Responsibility: at SQUER, we believe in empowering our team. In our flat hierarchies, your ideas and actions matter more than titles. Take the reins, make an impact and grow with us.
 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * We Value You: Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between 
€ 75.000 and € 95.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together
during the process.

jobs.description:
Mit A1 für morgen. Make it happen.

Was wir tun, tun wir mit Leidenschaft. Darum stellen wir Kund_innen smarte Technologie zur Verfügung, die vieles möglich macht. Wir arbeiten mit Verantwortung - sind dabei aber immer offen, neugierig und kreativ. Denn nur so ist man der Zeit einen Sprung voraus. 

Wir suchen 1 SOC Analyst with German (f/m/d) @ A1 Competence Delivery Center As a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting customer environments against cyber threats. You will monitor security events, investigate incidents, coordinate response activities and support customers in maintaining a strong security posture.

The role combines hands-on cybersecurity operations with incident investigation and customer-focused security support, providing exposure to diverse technologies, threat landscapes and international security environments.

Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Detection

Monitor customer environments for security threats, suspicious activities and policy violations, ensuring timely identification of potential risks.

Alert Analysis & Triage

Analyze and prioritize security alerts generated by SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, cloud and other security technologies, determining appropriate response actions.

Incident Investigation

Investigate security incidents, assess their severity, impact and business relevance, and distinguish between true positive and false positive events.

Incident Escalation & Response Support

Escalate validated incidents to customer security teams in accordance with established procedures and SLAs, while supporting incident response activities when required.

Customer Communication

Communicate incident details, recommendations and investigation findings to customers in a clear, professional and customer-oriented manner.

Threat Analysis & Correlation

Correlate information from multiple data sources to identify malicious activity, emerging threats and attack patterns across complex environments.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Document investigations, findings and response actions within ticketing and case management systems, while contributing to threat hunting, detection improvements and SOC process optimization.

Collaboration & Security Enhancement

Work closely with international colleagues, customers and technology partners to strengthen overall security capabilities and improve customer security posture.

Your Profile

 * Experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services, Incident Response or a similar cybersecurity role

 * Good understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques and incident handling processes

 * Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar or similar technologies

 * Familiarity with EDR/XDR solutions, Microsoft Defender, network security monitoring and cloud security services

 * Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess and prioritize security events effectively

 * Experience working in a customer-facing environment and communicating technical findings to various audiences

 * Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple incidents and maintain attention to detail

 * German language proficiency at C1 level or native speaker (mandatory)

 * Strong English communication skills

The minimum annual gross salary under the collective agreement of Telekom Austria AG for this position is EUR 51.042,74 (40-hour full-time work week). Depending on qualifications and professional experience, there is a willingness to offer a higher salary.
